errors.offline: You are offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.notFound: That item is no longer available.
errors.upstream: The service had a problem ({status}). Try again in a moment.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart Unison.
errors.noPlayableSource: This song can't play from any source here. Check that its extension is on.
errors.fileMissing: The file was moved or deleted. Use Locate file to find it.
errors.unsupportedFormat: Unison can't play this file type.
errors.drmProtected: This file is copy-protected (DRM) and can't be played.
errors.audiusUnavailable: Audius isn't reachable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.outputDeviceUnavailable: That audio output isn't available. Pick another one in Settings.
errors.extensionLinkInvalid: That isn't a link to an extension. Paste a GitHub repository, folder, extension.json, manifest.json or registry.json link, or a link to a package file.
errors.extensionInvalid: That extension isn't valid. Ask its author to fix it.
errors.extensionHostNotAllowed: The extension tried to reach a site it didn't declare, so Unison blocked it.
errors.extensionDisabled: This extension is off or removed. Turn it on in Settings → Extensions.
errors.extensionFailed: The extension's service sent something Unison couldn't use. Try again later.
errors.extensionRegistryInvalid: That registry.json isn't valid or lists no extensions. Ask its author to fix it.
errors.extensionUnsupported: Can't do that with this extension: it isn't an installable link, or it can't play in Unison.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.hint: Paste a registry link to browse its extensions, or a link to one extension (GitHub or a package file).
extensions.addsNothing: Adds nothing Unison can use: it only downloads files or offers features Unison doesn't have.
extensions.runsCode: Runs its own code in Unison's sandbox. It can only reach the sites below and can't touch your files.
extensions.trust: Only install extensions you trust that have the rights to the music they stream.
extensions.noneInstallable: None of these can be installed. Unison installs GitHub extensions and package files.
extensions.noInstalled: Nothing installed yet. Install an extension from a registry below, or paste its link.
extensions.emptyBody: Paste a registry link above to browse extensions you can add.
extensions.notFoundBody: It isn't installed and none of your registries lists it.
extensions.noDescription: The author didn't write a description.
extensions.typeDownloadBody: Saves songs as files. Unison doesn't download, so it uses only the stream link when there is one.
extensions.typeLyricsBody: Supplies lyrics. Unison doesn't show lyrics yet.
extensions.noTypes: The extension doesn't say what it provides.
extensions.cannot: Adds nothing Unison can use yet
